facts.en: Completed a digital media diploma at Fictional Amberchord College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构琥珀和弦学院完成数字媒体文凭课程。

facts.en: Provided paid freelance metadata-entry services to Fictional Ribbonnote Distribution under individual project agreements during 2024-03 to 2025-12.
facts.zh: 2024-03 至 2025-12 按单独项目协议，为虚构丝音发行公司提供有偿自由职业元数据录入服务。

facts.en: Those agreements describe independent project services, not employee status or continuous monthly work.
facts.zh: 这些协议描述独立项目服务，而非员工身份或每月连续工作。

facts.en: Entered track titles, artist display names and supplied contributor credits into delivery spreadsheets.
facts.zh: 将曲目名称、艺人显示名称及所提供的贡献者署名录入交付电子表格。

facts.en: Compared track order and audio filenames with label-approved release sheets.
facts.zh: 依据唱片公司获批发行表核对曲目顺序及音频文件名。

facts.en: Flagged missing contributor fields and asked the distributor’s coordinator for clarification.
facts.zh: 标记缺失的贡献者字段，并向发行商协调员请求澄清。

facts.en: The distributor’s coordinator approved final metadata and authorized submissions to platforms.
facts.zh: 发行商协调员批准最终元数据，并授权向平台提交。

facts.en: Retained invoices cover metadata delivery for 8 releases involving 6 fictional artists during those agreements.
facts.zh: 留存发票涵盖这些协议期间为 6 名虚构艺人的 8 次发行提供的元数据交付。

facts.en: A release may contain several tracks; the source records provide no complete total track count.
facts.zh: 一次发行可能包含多首曲目；来源记录未提供完整曲目总数。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet validation rules, controlled name lists and file-comparison checklists.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格验证规则、受控姓名列表及文件比较核对表。

facts.en: Drafted a contributor-name consistency checklist in 2025-02.
facts.zh: 2025-02 起草贡献者姓名一致性核对表。

facts.en: Used 10 invented examples to test punctuation and spacing rules; the coordinator reviewed the checklist.
facts.zh: 使用 10 个虚构示例测试标点及空格规则；协调员审阅该核对表。

facts.en: Stored dated delivery versions and itemized correction requests.
facts.zh: 保存带日期的交付版本，并逐项记录更正请求。

facts.en: The source records do not show access to royalty statements, revenue dashboards or rights contracts.
facts.zh: 来源记录未显示可访问版税报表、收入仪表板或权利合同。

facts.en: Completed a non-award audio-file formats workshop in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年完成不授予资格的音频文件格式工作坊。

facts.en: Created a personal catalogue of imaginary album covers in 2023, with original artwork and invented titles.
facts.zh: 2023 年使用原创美术及虚构名称制作个人想象专辑封面目录。

facts.en: Volunteered to check microphone checkout lists at Fictional Pinebeat Community Radio in 2022-08.
facts.zh: 2022-08 志愿为虚构松拍社区电台核对麦克风借出清单。

facts.en: Enjoys making short recordings of household percussion sounds.
facts.zh: 爱好录制短段家居打击声音。

facts.en: No songwriting, sound-mastering or royalty-accounting service is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录词曲创作、母带制作或版税核算服务。

facts.en: Used supplied English titles verbatim and entered supplied Chinese title text without providing translation.
facts.zh: 原样使用所提供的英文名称，并录入所提供的中文名称文字，不提供翻译。

facts.en: Some project invoices omit a delivery day, although the corresponding delivery email supplies the month.
facts.zh: 部分项目发票省略交付日，但相应交付邮件提供月份。
